institution: IIIT Pune (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Pune)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)
institute_disambiguation_note: This analysis covers IIIT Pune (the government/national-importance institute). A separate private institute, 'International Institute of Information Technology, Pune (I2IT)', also exists with distinctly lower ratings (2.9/5 overall) and should not be confused with IIIT Pune.

key_positive_themes.notes: IIIT Pune has moved to a new permanent campus offering better classrooms, upgraded computer labs, and a cleaner hostel environment — a significant step up from the earlier temporary campus shared with Trinity Academy of Engineering near Bopdev Ghat, about 15 km from Pune railway station.
Classrooms and laboratories well equipped for technical education; computing resources sufficient for advanced coursework and projects.
Highest-rated category (3.6/5); considered good value for money given the quality of education and placement opportunities.
Peaceful, organized campus ambiance suited to focused studying; students spend time on academics, projects, and placement preparation.

key_negative_themes.notes: Lowest-rated category (3.1/5); campus environment described as heavily academics-and-placement focused with limited extracurricular vibrancy compared to other institutes.
Campus described as not very large; while newly upgraded, it is still at a developing stage in terms of full amenities.
Some community Q&A responses note that fees are relatively high, and in past years placement outcomes were considered weaker compared to peer IIITs like IIIT Kota.
Academics rated 3.2/5, among the lower scores in this category compared to other IIITs analyzed, despite adequate infrastructure.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Good choice for students who want strong technical learning — functional infrastructure, good value for money given education and placement quality
To summarise it you will get excellent college life — new permanent campus better in all ways, big step up from earlier temporary campus
For CS I would recommend IIIT Kota over IIIT Pune as fees in IIIT Pune is high too and there were not many placements in past years
Currently sharing campus with Trinity Academy of Engineering near Bopdev Ghat, Pune, nearly 15 kilometers from Pune railway station

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Pune is moderately positive, with the recent transition to a new permanent campus marking a clear improvement over its earlier temporary, shared setup. However, ratings across academics and campus life remain relatively middling compared to top-performing IIITs, and some historical concerns persist about fees relative to placement outcomes in past years.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study. Care was taken to distinguish IIIT Pune from the separate, lower-rated private institute I2IT Pune.
